'''Aleksandr Vasilyevich Deryagin''' (Russian: Александр Васильевич Дерягин; 19 February 1941 – 16 July 2010), was a Russian politician who had served as the first Governor of [[Kaluga Oblast]] from 1991 to 1996. He was the corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences in 1991.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Дерягин А.В. - Общая информация |url=http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-354.ln-ru |access-date=2022-03-19 |website=www.ras.ru}}</ref>

==Biography==
Aleksandr Deryargin was born on 19 February 1941. In 1990, Deryagin was elected a people's deputy of the RSFSR, and in 1991 he was the chairman of the committee on science and public education of the Supreme Council of Russia. In the same year, he was a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Дерягин А.В. - Общая информация |url=http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-354.ln-ru |access-date=2022-03-19 |website=www.ras.ru}}</ref> In 1997, he was the President of the Kaluga Scientific Center.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2010-11-07 |title=Калужский научный центр - Информация о Центре |url=http://www.science-kaluga.ru/about/ |access-date=2022-03-19 |website= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101107110655/http://www.science-kaluga.ru/about/ |archive-date=7 November 2010 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Aleksandr Vasilyevich Deryagin died in Kaluga on 16 July 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Правительство Калужской области и губернатор выразили соболезнования близким и родным Александра Дерягина |url=https://regnum.ru/news/society/1305367.html |access-date=2022-03-19 |website=ИА REGNUM |language=ru}}</ref> In 2011, the Kaluga Regional Research Center was renamed dedicated to his name in his memory.<ref>{{cite web
|url=http://www.vest-news.ru/news/34927
|title=Научный центр получил имя своего основателя А.В. Дерягина
|publisher=www.vest-news.ru
|accessdate=2011-03-25}}</ref>
